get.summary: Get the authenticated user, their profile, and their organization
get.description: Answers for an account without a membership too, with `membership: null`, so the SPA can tell that apart from a failure.

200.description: Verified user identity with profile and membership

401.description: A valid user access token is required

patch.description: Creates the profile when the account has none yet.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

get.summary: List open invitations sent to the authenticated user's address
get.description: For onboarding, so a person is told about an invitation before creating an organization of their own. Carries no id and no token: only the emailed link accepts an invitation.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

get.description: Paginated. Archived clients are never listed. One sort key at a time; "legalName" is the default.

200.description: One page of active clients with the total count

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

post.summary: Create a client in the organization

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

409.description: A client with this CUI already exists

get.summary: Read one client, archived or not

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: The client does not exist in the organization

get.summary: Look up public company data by CUI (ANAF)

200.description: Public registry data to prefill a client

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: No company registered with this CUI

get.description: Paginated. Without a status filter the list holds current employees. Archived rows are never listed. One sort key at a time; "name" orders by last name then first name. The CNP is only returned by the detail route.

200.description: One page of employees with the total count

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: The client does not exist in the organization

post.summary: Add an employee to a client

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: The client does not exist in the organization

409.description: The client is archived, or the CNP or employee number is already used

get.summary: Read one employee, including the CNP

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: The employee does not exist under this client in the organization

patch.summary: Mark an employee as former, or reactivate one
patch.description: Terminating needs the leave date, on or after the hire date. Reactivating clears it and is meant for undoing a mistake; a rehire after a gap is a new employee.

400.description: Invalid path or body, or a leave date before the hire date

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

404.description: The employee does not exist under this client in the organization

post.summary: Create an organization and become its owner
post.description: Onboarding. For a signed-in account with a confirmed email and no membership. Names the caller and records their acceptance of the terms on the organization.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account's email is not confirmed

409.description: The account already belongs to an organization; see `reason`

get.description: Every member may read it. Ordered by when people joined; not paginated.

200.description: The members with their names, emails, and roles

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not a member of an organization

patch.description: Owners only, and never on their own membership, which is what keeps an organization from ending up without an owner.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

404.description: No such member in the organization

delete.summary: Remove a member from the organization
delete.description: Owners only, and never themselves. Only the membership is deleted: the account, the profile, and what the person created stay, and they can be invited again.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

404.description: No such member in the organization

get.description: Owners only. Open and expired invitations, newest first; accepted and revoked ones are left out.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

post.summary: Invite a person into the organization by email
post.description: Owners only. Inviting an address that already has a pending invitation renews it and sends a fresh link. The response never says whether the address has an account.

201.description: The invitation, with its email sent

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

409.description: Already a member, too many open invitations, or an email was sent in the last 10 minutes; see `reason`

post.summary: Renew a pending invitation and email a fresh link
post.description: Owners only. The earlier link stops working.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

404.description: No pending invitation with this id

409.description: An email was sent in the last 10 minutes

post.description: Owners only. The emailed link stops working.

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The account is not an owner of an organization

404.description: No pending invitation with this id

post.summary: Describe the invitation behind an emailed token
post.description: Public, and changes nothing, so a mail scanner opening the link cannot accept. A POST keeps the token out of URLs.

200.description: The invitation and whether its address already has an account

post.summary: Create an account from an invitation and join the organization
post.description: Public. For an address without an account; the token proves control of the mailbox, so the account is created confirmed. Sign in with the chosen password afterwards.

201.description: The account exists and is a member

400.description: Invalid request body or a rejected password

409.description: The invitation is not open, or the address has an account; see `reason`

post.summary: Join the organization with the signed-in account
post.description: For an account without a membership whose confirmed email is the invited address. `fullName` is required only when the account has no profile.

200.description: The account is now a member

400.description: Invalid request body, or a name is needed

401.description: A valid user access token is required

403.description: The invitation was sent to a different address

409.description: The invitation is not open, or the account already belongs to an organization; see `reason`

post.summary: Ask to be told when accounts open
post.description: Public. Stores the address as pending and emails a confirmation link. The response is the same whether or not the address was already known.

202.description: A confirmation email is on its way, unless one was sent recently

400.description: Invalid body or failed Turnstile check

get.summary: Confirm a waitlist subscription from the emailed link
get.description: Opened in a browser. Always redirects to a page on the marketing site.

303.description: Redirect to the confirmed or the invalid-link page
